items.title: 1 Ears read as thin dark horns
items.evidence: 1_beauty az000: ears are broad brown leaves with dark cup, matching 5_reference front; but hero, az090 and 2_closeups head wire still show a thin spike-like ear, tip not clearly ahead of base.

items.title: 2 Crest is identical sawteeth
items.evidence: 1_beauty az090 and back34: crest dense, clumps vary in height and width, tallest at the withers, tapering toward the rump, no bare nape; 3_tech float 0, hit 0.

items.title: 3 Face has no eye or brow
items.evidence: 1_beauty az000: both dark almond eyes under a dark brow V are readable at thumbnail size; hero and az090 show the eye lens in shadow.

items.title: 4 Hind legs straight columns
items.evidence: 1_beauty az090: hind leg shows a hock bulge set back with the cannon angled forward to a planted hoof; 3_tech hind leg clean, hit 0, IoU .967; cannon-front flatten not done, minor.

items.title: 5 Mantle border one straight diagonal; brown too orange
items.evidence: Body brown now darker, closer to the reference (1_beauty az090); but the mantle lower edge in az090 and hero still reads as a near-straight diagonal, with only a faint shoulder dip compared to the saddle in 5_reference side.

regressions: 3_tech/techqa: clip 2 (0.01%, crest under the ear in the toss) is a new warning, baseline 0; other keep items (mass, snout and tusks, 0 hit/float/drift/flips) held
